android.desc:
A 3D puzzle platformer game set in a fantasy world.

The first chapter of the Skylander saga, Uplift will lead you in a startling adventure across a series of levels which will challenge both your wits and your reflexes.

Take control of your own airship and help professor Flugen and his crew search for the rare heltrogen gas, the precious element which can save their floating city. 

Enjoy a steam punk flavoured adventure and steer your blimp through the most diverse obstacles, from nature's forces (furious ravens, hungry eagles and unpredictable geysers) to the war zeppelins of the insidious Ark.

Discover a COMPLETELY FREE unique arcade and puzzle combination! No extra charges, no ads and no personal data collection!

FEATURES:

Use the options menu to choose from 3 different ways of controlling your airship.

Original 3D graphics

Ambient lighting, shaders & effects

Real time physics

A unique arcade and puzzle combination

A compelling story, further enhanced by the Lorebook

Original music and sounds

Completely free, no hidden charges


Did the first chapter catch your attention? Would you like to find out the rest of the story? You can download it now from Google Play - Uplift: Chronicles ().

Minimum requirements:

Android 4.1 or above
1GHz CPU (single core)
512 MB RAM
Graphic chip: Adreno 205 / PowerVR SGX540 / Tegra 2 / Mali-400MP
100 MB free space

Due to the fact that we have limited funds to upgrade our game engine to the latest version, on some devices the game my exhibit crashes or other unstable behavior. We have never experienced this on our test devices, but some users have reported this. We apologise for this inconvenience or any other similar problems, unfortunately, since this is a problem related to our limited financial resources rather than our programming skills, we are unable to have a fix at the current moment. Thank you for your understanding.

NOTE: The game installation will require you to download an additional 65MB of data. We apologise for any inconvenience this might cause.

WARNING: Everyone upgrading from version 0.726 to version 1.00 will lose their previous savegames.

Visit us on our Facebook page: http://www.facebook.com/pages/Starchaser-Studios/244047328950985

Permissions explained:

MODIFY OR DELETE THE CONTENTS OF YOUR USB STORAGE - Needed by the game to install itself, load and save games.

Privacy Policy: http://www.starchaser.ro/PP/privacy_policy_upliftfree.
